description: Migrated Neo4j to native Zero-Docker Community 5.26.0 with dedicated OpenJDK 21 LTS runtime (.tools/jdk-21). Eliminated trial expiration.
Configured native neo4j MCP server using uvx mcp-neo4j-cypher with FastMCP stdio transport connected to bolt://localhost:7687.
Implemented OpenTelemetry-compatible traceId, spanId, and W3C traceparent propagation in packages/shared-logger.
Created and executed rich multi-property hospitality simulation seeder (3 hotels, luxury room types, physical inventory).
Added multi-matrix GitHub Actions CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) and automated AST graph sync pre-push hook.
Released Version 6.9.0 (package.json v6.9.0, current-state.md v6.9.0-complete-certified) and pushed to GitHub origin/main with tag v6.9.0.
Resolved GitHub Actions deployment workflow failures by replacing invalid job-level secrets with graceful step-level diagnostics.
